chunks: As for the report of Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
A free man does not perform liʿan against a female slave, nor against a dhimmiyyah, nor against a woman with whom he is in mut'ah.

key_terms.الذِّمِّيَّةَ: a non-Muslim woman under dhimmah protection
key_terms.الرَّجُلُ الْحُرُّ: a free man, as distinct from a slave
key_terms.يَتَمَتَّعُ بِهَا: is joined with in temporary marriage (mut'ah)
key_terms.يُلَاعِنُ: performs liʿan, the formal mutual cursing procedure

ai.seo_question: In which cases does a free man not perform liʿan according to Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning liʿan and identifies categories of women with whom a free man does not enter into this procedure. It pertains to family law and judicial rulings related to marital status and legal eligibility for liʿan.
